request: Qualify corrected DebugAI review evidence count and trigger existing deterministic CI after focused PASS; no AI/external review or runtime deploy

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
w="$p/.worktrees/hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028"
branch=fix/debugai-hypothesis-review-evidence-20261028
expected=9ccd69ad2754b070aa1798d4473a312f0ca44e03
[ "$(realpath "$w")" = "$w" ]
[ -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ] || { echo SOURCE_DIRTY; exit 4; }
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/$branch"
[ "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$expected" ] || { echo BRANCH_MOVED; exit 4; }
git -C "$w" checkout --detach "$expected" >/dev/null
image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 128 --memory 768m --cpus 1 \
 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777 \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/workflow.js,target=/app/server/workflow.js,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs,target=/app/server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs,readonly" \
 --mount "type=bind,source=$w/compose.yaml,target=/app/compose.yaml,readonly" \
 --entrypoint node "$image" \
 --test server/tests/workflow-hypothesis-review-evidence.test.cjs server/tests/external-review-verdict-contract.test.cjs server/tests/workflow-diagnoser-horizontal-continuation.test.cjs server/tests/workflow-six-role-horizontal-entry.test.cjs
echo DEBUGAI_FOCUSED=PASS
if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 gh workflow run ci.yml --repo seigo-gace/debug-ai --ref "$branch" >/dev/null
 echo DEBUGAI_VERIFY_DISPATCH=YES
else echo DEBUGAI_VERIFY_DISPATCH=GH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE; fi
echo DEBUGAI_SOURCE_SHA="$expected"
echo CREATED_NEW_TOP_LEVEL_SIBLING=NO
